about: S. K. Offset is a Meerut (Uttar Pradesh) based printing, packaging and labelling company. It prints books and pamphlets, makes mono cartons, rigid boxes and cartons, and prints labels and stickers, operating from four facilities in Meerut with about 38,313 sq ft covered area. It sells mainly to B2B customers in North India (84% of revenue) and also trades printing materials.

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for purchase of plant and machinery (foil stamper and die cutter) at Meerut

promoters.background: Promoters are directors with experience in offset printing and packaging and are actively involved in operations and sales; company incorporated Feb 2007 and converted to public limited in Aug 2025.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 86.14% of FY26 revenue and the largest customer alone 30.41%; no firm contracts, orders are purchase-order based.

litigation_note: No criminal proceedings or material litigation pending against the company as per RHP; no contingent liabilities in FY24-FY26.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 21.53 crore in FY24 to Rs 66.67 crore in FY26, and PAT rose from Rs 0.72 crore to Rs 7.48 crore.
EBITDA margin improved from 5.39% to 21.27% as higher-value packaging grew to 39.7% of FY26 revenue.
ROCE and RoNW improved to 22.91% and 37.82% in FY26.
In-house design, pre-press, printing, finishing and packaging gives control over quality and timelines.
Serves publishing, FMCG, pharma, cosmetics and food customers, with ISO-certified quality systems.
Promoters are experienced in offset printing and packaging and actively manage sales and operations.
Debt-equity improved from 4.49 times in FY25 to 1.75 times in FY26 after the Dec 2025 loan-to-equity conversion and profits.
Planned foil stamping machine can raise hot foil capacity from 36 lakh to 180 lakh sheets a year for premium finishes.

risks.title: Heavy customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers were 86.14% of FY26 revenue and the top customer 30.41%. There are no long-term contracts, only purchase orders.

risks.title: High debt and working capital dependence
risks.detail: Borrowings were Rs 34.58 crore at Mar-26 (Rs 31.79 crore secured, Rs 2.79 crore unsecured repayable on demand), with debt-equity of 1.75 times. About Rs 18.66 crore of IPO money goes to working capital.

risks.title: Volatile and weak cash flows
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs 4.40 crore, minus Rs 10.80 crore and Rs 3.66 crore in FY24, FY25 and FY26, and the company has had negative cash flows before.

risks.title: Very rapid growth on a small base
risks.detail: Revenue more than tripled and trade receivables rose to Rs 34.47 crore in FY26 (52% of revenue); collection delays could hurt cash.

risks.title: Related party loans and common pursuits
risks.detail: Promoters and relatives lent money and had loans converted into shares; a promoter group firm, Arun Packers and Printers, is in a similar business.

risks.title: Lenders' consent and director guarantees
risks.detail: NOCs from some lenders for the IPO are not received, loans have restrictive covenants and are backed by director guarantees.

risks.title: Premises leased and single-state operations
risks.detail: Registered office and plants are leased and all manufacturing is in Uttar Pradesh; 84.35% of revenue comes from North India.

risks.title: Weak governance and no fund monitoring
risks.detail: Restated financials are signed by a peer-review auditor who is not the statutory auditor, corporate record discrepancies exist, and no monitoring agency tracks use of IPO funds.

notes: Standalone restated financials in lakhs converted to Rs crore. Financial-year data FY24-FY26 only. Price band, issue size in Rs, P/E and post-issue promoter holding are blank in the RHP. Fresh issue of up to 23,25,000 shares including 1,20,000 market maker shares; Rs 18.66 crore working capital and Rs 2.11 crore capex amounts from objects table. Reserves = reserves and surplus (net worth minus share capital). Cash is cash and cash equivalents only. Reservation percentages are minimum or maximum limits for the net issue. Top-supplier and packaging KPIs from business section.
